verdict: CHART CRITERION ON A WHOLE CELL (checks 7/7): the payoff stops being POINTWISE. A review was right to refuse calling a slice-point computation (h = 0) a full result: here everything is certified on the WHOLE BOX. THE SECTION IS COMPLETE on 4 of 4 cells, with the determination chosen PER ROW and serialised (principal/rotated); the established complementarity makes the three rows covered, so the six ambient coordinates exist. THE JACOBIAN DOES NOT DEPEND ON THE DETERMINATION: from Z_s^2 = R_s, valid for both, one gets dZ_s/du = d_u R_s/(2 Z_s) = a_1.u/Z_s, and the pilot formula carries over verbatim. RESULT: of 236 charts examined, 236 reachable, **74 admissible** (gauge bounded away from 0, |u'| at most 1, |v'| at most 1 AND det J nonzero, all on the whole box), of which **62 certified DISJOINT from their own real slice**, [15, 16, 15, 16] per cell. Under the principal branch that set was EMPTY: this is the lock of the pilot, now crossed ON ONE CELL, not at one point. NEGATIVE CONTROLS: a box whose component is determined AT THE CENTRE but UNDETERMINED on the box is REFUSED, and the centre-only mutation wrongly accepts it (which is what makes the test discriminating); a gauge of centre 1/2 whose enclosure contains 0 is refused. SCOPE: **congruence (Q_source = J* Q_target J) and positivity transport stay UNTESTED**; the success of the checks above does not prejudge them. Result established on 4 cells, not on a cover.
